dedupe_keys.name: new geospatial dataset of dams and reservoirs in switzerland with georeferenced dam locations

description: New Geospatial Dataset of Dams and Reservoirs in Switzerland with Georeferenced Dam Locations is a data set deposited in ETH Zürich Research Collection by its authors Leon Adamus. This dataset contains georeferenced information on large and most smaller dams and reservoirs in Switzerland, including dam names, coordinates, years of construction, and maximum reservoir volumes. It was created as part of a bachelor's thesis at ETH Zurich in the Chair of Hydrology and Water Resources Management. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
